name: Qui Nhon
summary: A coastal city in south-central Vietnam, and a refueling stop on the longest day of flying Larry describes: "One time took off at 4am, refilled at Qui Nhon, and that where I bought my camera the PX - Post Xchange army store. We flew back in about 11 pm at night. we were all over the country that day." The camera is behind much of this collection. "I got the camera about 3-weeks into Vietnam which would have been Oct of 1964."
researchNotes: Chiefly significant for the collection's own provenance: photographs taken with Larry's own camera postdate this stop, which on his 2026-09-12 estimate (giscus-vn-0017-c18415788) was about October 1964. His son's paraphrase names the camera as a Canon Dial 35 (giscus-vn-0023-c18035521); the model was introduced in 1963, consistent with a 1964 PX purchase. The flight is in giscus-vn-0016-c18032603. 2026-09-15, standard public place names (his son's rule, CLAUDE.md "Place names"): name was "Qui Nhơn" and the alternate name "Qui Nhon"; the modern Vietnamese spelling Quy Nhơn shows as the vietnameseName line. Larry bought his camera at the PX there ("refilled at Qui Nhon").
